table.name: TLGNC_DRIVER_BREAK
table.description: Stores timeperiods when a certain driver is on break. These can be either planned breaks, or breaks defined by the driver on his PDA (MOP breaks). Planned breaks cannot overlap with other planned breaks, MOP breaks cannot overlap with other MOP breaks

column.name: DRIVER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_driver. Driver ID, to which this record is related.

column.name: START_DAT
column.description: The start date/time of the driver break.

column.name: END_DAT
column.description: The end date/time of the driver break. In case it's open end, a hardcoded date of 31.12.9999=infinite is set.

column.name: IS_LUNCH_BREAK
column.description: If set, this entry overrides the defalt lunch break, else we have a default lunch break, as defined in the config table. Can only be set if for planned breaks.

column.name: IS_MOP_BREAK
column.description: True, if the break is defined on the driver's PDA
